name: Lake Shore Realty Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1987, Mahaan Foods Limited is engaged in manufacturing of dairy products and pharma nutritional products.
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
Company processes skimmed milk to manufacture Dairy Whitener, Skimmed Milk Powder, Whole Milk Powder, Instantized Milk Powders, Baby Foods and other milk based products.
a) Domestic Markets: Ghee is marketed under brand name MAHAAN. It is available in packages from 200 ml. to 5 Kg. in refill packs, HDPE jars and tin containers.
Skimmed milk powder is supplied in pack sizes of 1 kg and 25 kg under brand name “MAHAAN”.
Sweetened Milk Powder is supplied in various pack sizes under different brands like Mahaan, Every Time, Energy, Classic, Amar Spray, Sumona & Radhey, etc.
b) Institutions: Company supplies Skimmed Milk Powder and Whole Milk Powder to institutions for use as raw material for manufacturing of their products in 25 kg bulk pack size.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -38.2%
Company has a low return on equity of 3.42% over last 3 years.
